europe_now.title: Iceland Referendum on EU Membership Talks
europe_now.summary: Icelanders are voting in a referendum on whether to resume EU membership negotiations, an existential question for the nation's foreign policy. The outcome will determine Iceland's future relationship with the European Union and its geopolitical alignment.

sources.headline: Iceland votes on whether to resume EU membership negotiations
Referendum on EU membership: An ‘existential question’ for Icelanders

europe_now.title: Russian Strike on Kyiv Warehouse Kills Dozens
europe_now.summary: A Russian drone strike on a warehouse near Kyiv resulted in at least 27 deaths and hundreds of evacuations. The attack targeted a munitions depot, underscoring the severe security threat and civilian impact of the ongoing conflict.

sources.headline: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot

top_stories.title: Aftermath of the Kyiv Warehouse Strike
top_stories.summary: A Russian drone strike on a warehouse near Kyiv killed at least two dozen people and forced hundreds to evacuate. The targeted facility was storing munitions, according to Ukrainian officials, as rescue operations continued into the night.

top_stories.title: EU Pushes for Multilingual AI Chatbots
top_stories.summary: The European Union is moving to require AI chatbots to support all of its official languages rather than focusing primarily on English. This regulatory push aims to ensure inclusivity and compliance with EU digital policies across member states.

sources.headline: AI chatbots need to work in all EU languages, not just English

top_stories.title: Serbia Navigates EU and Russia Relations Before Election
top_stories.summary: Serbia is balancing its relations with the European Union and Russia ahead of a key national election. The country's foreign policy direction remains a critical focus as voters prepare to head to the polls.
